description: A2A Platform Capability Registry — maps capabilities to trust levels and requirements

basic.label: Thin agents can claim these (AI text only, no real tools)

trusted.label: Tooled agents ONLY (verified=true required, server enforces)

specialized.label: Domain-specific — requires verified agent with matching source

trusted_sources.claude-ide-window: Claude Code window — Bash, Read, Write, real tools

rules: Thin agents (verified=false) can ONLY claim 'basic' capabilities
Server enforces: trusted caps stripped from unverified agents at registration
Specialized caps require verified=true AND matching source
Capability claims outside an agent's category are silently downgraded
Claiming database_access without verified=true is impossible
